name: Browbeat Enforcement
body:
You break down mental defenses with your potent will.

Prerequisite(s): Will enforcement spell-like ability.

Benefit(s): You can use will enforcement without applying the will effect. The target may submit to the will effect to suppress the enforcement as normal. Using will enforcement in this way expends a daily use of the ability but does not expend a spell slot.
